The '''Bank of Aargau''' was a subsidiary of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]. The Bank had a large branch in the [[Financial District (Coruscant)/Legends|Financial District]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and was headquartered on [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]].

During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the Bank of Aargau began emptying out all safety deposit boxes in the bank that had lain unclaimed for more than four hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="SWTOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Bank on Us}}</ref>

After the [[Dorvalla Incident]], the stolen credits that made their way to [[House Valorum]] were channeled through the Bank. The IG codes used to communicate with the bank were the basis for the codes [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] used to communicate with the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]].

The Bank of Aargau was responsible for handling nearly every aspect of financial transactions within the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] and as a result the bank was a primary driving force behind the government on Aargau. The [[Bank of Aargau Security, Ltd.]] was a subsidiary of the Bank of Aargau and was responsible for ensuring the security of their vaults, and was large enough to secure the neutrality of the planet Aargau during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

[[Walon Vau]] had an account in the Bank of Aargau where he invested both his mercenary earnings and his [[Cuy'val Dar]] fee.

In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] the bank had a branch on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] where [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] had an account.
